name: Pyrilamine
aliases: Anthisan®, mepiramine, pyranisamine, pyrilamine tannate, Pyrlex®
summary: Mepyramine, also known as pyrilamine, is a first-generation antihistamine, targeting the H1 receptor as an inverse agonist. Mepyramine rapidly permeates the brain, often causing drowsiness. It is often sold as a maleate salt, pyrilamine maleate. The medication has negligible anticholinergic activity, with 130,000-fold selectivity for the histamine H1 receptor over the muscarinic acetylcholine receptors.

pharmacology.text: Mepyramine, also known as pyrilamine, is a first-generation antihistamine, targeting the H1 receptor as an inverse agonist. The medication has negligible anticholinergic activity, with 130,000-fold selectivity for the histamine H1 receptor over the muscarinic acetylcholine receptors (for comparison, diphenhydramine had 20-fold selectivity for the H1 receptor).

uses.text: It is often sold as a maleate salt, pyrilamine maleate. The medication has negligible anticholinergic activity, with 130,000-fold selectivity for the histamine H1 receptor over the muscarinic acetylcholine receptors (for comparison, diphenhydramine had 20-fold selectivity for the H1 receptor). It was patented in 1943 and came into medical use in 1949.

sideEffects.en: Common effects include drowsiness, dizziness, dry mouth, blurred vision and stomach upset. Large amounts can cause confusion, agitation and seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 常見副作用包括嗜睡、頭暈、口乾、視力模糊和腸胃不適。大量使用可能引起意識混亂、躁動和癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 常见副作用包括嗜睡、头晕、口干、视力模糊和肠胃不适。大量使用可能引起意识混乱、躁动和癫痫发作。

fact.en: Mepyramine was one of the first antihistamines, introduced in the 1940s. A radioactive form of it was later used to map H1 histamine receptors in the brain for the first time.
fact.zh: Mepyramine 是最早的抗組織胺之一，在 1940 年代問世。後來研究人員用它的放射性標記版本，首次描繪出大腦中 H1 組織胺受體的分布。
fact.zhHans: Mepyramine 是最早的抗组织胺之一，在 1940 年代问世。后来研究人员用它的放射性标记版本，首次描绘出大脑中 H1 组织胺受体的分布。
